# solution-explorer architecture site

> This site is an interactive architecture viewer with a machine-readable
> projection of the codebase. An agent can answer questions about the code by
> fetching small JSON files instead of reading the raw repository.

## Start here

- [architecture/ai.json](./architecture/ai.json): the dataset-specific front door: endpoint map, sharding schemes, walk orders, and the token-economy contract. Read this first.
- [architecture/llms.txt](./architecture/llms.txt): the markdown companion for the projection.
- [architecture/manifest.json](./architecture/manifest.json): the structural entry document (components, relationships, stats, findings).
